description: Allaman Castle stands on an esplanade above the road in the municipality of Allaman, a medieval castle whose main fabric dates from 1253, with park and vineyards around the walls. It replaces Rolle Castle, already published with the Île de la Harpe. It does not stand in the lake. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and cool, about 13°C, with a breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
